installToAgent.explain1: For Claude Code, bundled plugins are unpacked wholesale into ~/.claude/skills/sawhorse (skills-dir plugin — loaded automatically, no install step). Hand-edited files are not overwritten; they appear as

wizard.title: Get started with the sawhorse workbench

intro.lead: Your workflow defines how work gets done.
intro.rest: Sawhorse deterministically ports stages, deliverables, approvals, and extensions. A particular delivery format or development method belongs to the selected workflow, not the core app.
intro.programs: Checks only the shared recommended integrations, Obsidian and herdr. Tools such as Node.js and Pandoc are declared by workflows that need them.
intro.agents: Scans this PC's terminal agents and picks one to use as the default.
intro.vault: One folder where documents live. An existing Obsidian vault works as is.
intro.packs: Optional feature bundles. Their views, schedules, and skills are used only by workflows that need them.
intro.skills: Installs the skills of enabled extensions into the agents.
intro.outro: Set things in order and you're done. You can change everything later in Settings and the Extensions tab.

vault.hint: Absolute path of the folder where documents live. If it doesn't exist, the app creates it. If you use Obsidian, point it at your existing vault.
vault.label: Workspace absolute path
vault.noRecords: No Obsidian vault records found. Type a path yourself.

packs.hint: Enabled extensions are this app's features. Turning one off removes its views, schedules, and actions (documents are kept).

done.setupDesc: One more check covering hooks and MCP settings, with a report of the results.

github.extensionDesc: Connect an account to browse repositories and import projects and issues. Disabling the extension keeps your account and connection settings.
github.oauthDesc: Signs in with GitHub OAuth in your browser. It requests the repo scope to import private repositories, but Sawhorse only uses it to read repositories and issues.
github.codeHint: Enter the code below on the GitHub page in your browser and approve.
github.waiting: Waiting for approval… The code is valid for about {{minutes}} minutes.
github.openFailed: Couldn't open your browser automatically. Use the button below to open the GitHub auth page.
github.keychainNote: The OAuth token is stored only in this Mac's keychain. No need to create or paste a personal access token.
github.issueLinked: Linked {{repo}} issues to project “{{project}}”. Check which issues to import in Manage issue sync.
github.linkNeedsProject: No project to link to. Import the repository as a project first.
github.linkHint: The selected project gets bound to this repository, and imported issues become work items of that project.
github.importHint: Creates a new folder named after the repository inside the selected folder.
